decisions.rationale: The stroke is the long descender of the f of "full" (line 1), which loops down past "them," of line 2 without joining any letter there.
The stroke is the long f of "of" in "weight of dry" (line 6); its tail crosses into "that" on line 7 but none of line 7's letters is part of this component.
The stroke is the g of "Sugar" (line 6) with its descender tail, which ends above "Liquor," on line 7.
Two letters really joined: the tail of the g of "sug." (line 8) runs into the top of the k of "Looks" (line 9); the automatic valley row 1632 lies at the meeting point and is kept as the cut.

Two letters really joined: the o of "to" (line 9) touches the curled ascender of the d of "red" (line 10); the cut is moved up to row 1684, just under the bowl of the o, so the whole curl stays with the d.

One pen stroke: the bowl of the g of "keeping" (line 10) continues as the long descender that becomes the closing rule under "The time it Boils" (line 11); the bowl stays with line 10 and the descender and rule go with line 11 at the automatic valley row 1761.

The stroke is the f of "of" in the title (line 0) with its long descender; the descender runs down beside the "i" of "ripe," on line 1 and ends in a hook short of it, without joining any letter of line 1. Needed once the note "full ripe," quotes the words of line 1 instead of a mis-cut box (word-cut-inside-word).
